tooling.message:
docs(plan): guidance by phase, the workshop page and the start pages; open issues and clean-up

## Intent

The plan of the increment had not been updated since 18 October, and open issues were missing. Before the first end-to-end version of the tooling is closed, the plan must say what was built, what was cleaned up and what remains.

## Key changes

- KD-24 records one skill per phase, guidance that only describes the process, and the workshop page rendered from the x-* attributes of the architecture. Rejected: a mapping file beside the architecture, and x-kind.
- Completed lists the work of 19 and 20 October across the repos; Code lists its follow-ups.
- The open issues are in the plan: #117 (update cannot be committed), the rest of #115, and later work outside this increment.
- The interactive pilot is done; #20, #115, .github#12 and apps#60 are closed. The comparison of old and new guidance in the evals is the last step before closing.

## Dependencies and side effects

- app-templates moves to arc42 0.38.0 in 938b582.

app-templates.reason: The only app-templates commit of this clean-up.
app-templates.message:
chore(deps): @doctc/arc42 0.38.0, as the tooling pins it

## Intent

The templates should use the same arc42 version as the tooling, which now reports custom x-* attributes.

## Key changes

- @doctc/arc42 moves to 0.38.0. It reports the x-* attributes of an element in arc42 get and no longer cuts its JSON at 64 KiB on a pipe.
- All three architectures pass arc42 validate --strict unchanged.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The plan of the increment (tooling, 78e1fbc and following) lists this as part of the clean-up.

moved.why: The arc42 bump is one item of the clean-up asked for in the same exchange about the plan and the issues; i155 is merged into this intent and has no commits left.
